select.where: del_flag ='0' and INSTR(machine_code, #{machineCode}) > 0 and machine_name like concat(concat('%',#{machineName}), '%') and status = #{status}

id, machine_code, machine_name, efficiency, tooling_info, quata, class_shift, open_machine_class, status, remark, del_flag, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time,
#{id}, #{machineCode}, #{machineName}, #{efficiency}, #{toolingInfo}, #{quata}, #{classShift}, #{openMachineClass}, #{status}, #{remark}, #{delFlag}, #{createBy}, #{createTime}, #{updateBy}, #{updateTime},
mapper.delete:
UPDATE t_tq_machine_info SET del_flag ='1' where id in
#{id}

select.if: select a.MACHINE_ID as ID,b.MACHINE_CODE,b.MACHINE_NAME from T_TQ_SPECIFY_MACHINE a inner JOIN T_TQ_MACHINE_INFO b on a.MACHINE_ID=b.ID and b.STATUS = '0' where a.DEL_FLAG='0' and a.JOB_TYPE='0' and a.BEAD_CODE=#{machineCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

select a.MACHINE_ID as ID,b.MACHINE_CODE,b.MACHINE_NAME from T_TQ_MOUTH_PLATE a inner JOIN T_TQ_MACHINE_INFO b on a.MACHINE_ID=b.ID and b.STATUS = '0' where a.DEL_FLAG='0' and a.STATUS='0' and a.MOUTH_PLATE_CODE=#{machineName,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and a.MACHINE_ID not in ( select MACHINE_ID from T_TQ_SPECIFY_MACHINE where DEL_FLAG='0' and JOB_TYPE='0' and BEAD_CODE=#{machineCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} )

select a.ID,a.MACHINE_CODE,a.MACHINE_NAME from t_tq_machine_info a where a.DEL_FLAG='0' and a.STATUS='0' and a.ID not in ( select MACHINE_ID from T_TQ_SPECIFY_MACHINE where DEL_FLAG='0' and JOB_TYPE='0' and BEAD_CODE=#{machineCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} union select MACHINE_ID from T_TQ_MOUTH_PLATE where DEL_FLAG='0' and STATUS='0' and MOUTH_PLATE_CODE=#{machineName,jdbcType=VARCHAR} )
